title: Retention mechanism, transfer device, handling robot system, and unloading device
abstract: To provide a retention mechanism, a transfer device, a handling robot system, and an unloading device that are capable of easily holding an article.SOLUTION: A retention mechanism includes: a base having one end, a structure connection mechanism, a drive part, and a regulation member. The structure connection mechanism includes a connection member for connecting at least two or more structures with the structure, and is rotatable in a first rotation direction about a first shaft, whereas partly restricted in rotation in a second rotation direction about the first shaft. The regulation member is provided at a prescribed distance from the one end. The drive part moves the structure connection mechanism in a first direction from the one end toward the regulation member. According to drive of the drive part, a projection part of the structure connection mechanism projecting beyond the one end projects in a second direction substantially orthogonal to the first direction after passing between the one end and the regulation member. The regulation member regulates movement of the projection part in the first direction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: Position holding mechanism and image forming apparatus
abstract: To prevent falling from a holding position.SOLUTION: A position holding mechanism comprises: a connection member 10 that is provided on any one of an outer door and an inner door and includes a slide hole 12; and a connection boss 4 that is provided on the other of the outer door and the inner door and is connected to the slide hole 12 to slide the slide hole 12 in association with rotation of the inner door with respect to the outer door. The slide hole 12 has, in communication with each other, a first wide part 12a, a second wide part 12c and a third wide part 12f in which the length in a width direction W orthogonal to a slide direction D2 in which the connection boss 4 slides is equal to or longer than the length d1 in the width direction W of the connection boss 4, a first narrow part 12b that is provided between the first wide part 12a and the second wide part 12c and is less than the length in the width direction W of the connection boss 4, and a second narrow part 12d that is provided between the second wide part 12c and the third wide part 12f and is less than the length in the width direction W of the connection boss 4.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title: Reel rack
abstract: To provide a reel rack capable of stably storing a reel body which a tape body for holding electronic component is wound.SOLUTION: A reel rack is provided with at least two support rods spaced apart, an edge of a reel body around which a tape body for holding an electronic component is wound is brought into contact with a contact portion on an outer circumference of each support rod so that reel body is place, a contact portion is provided with a static eliminator that removes static electricity from the reel body, and the static eliminator is provided so as to come into contact with the reel body and suppress misalignment in a longitudinal direction. Since the static eliminator can reliably contact an edge of the reel body to remove the static electricity and suppress a displacement of the reel body in the longitudinal direction, the reel body placed on the support rod is stable, and damage due to tipping can be reduced.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: connector
abstract: To realize an application to an inner housing in which a connector fitting direction is a die-cutting direction.SOLUTION: An inner housing 30 has a first holding part 33 protruding from each of a pair of side wall surfaces 32 and a pair of second holding parts 34 protruding from each of a pair of side wall surfaces without being disposed to face each of the first holding part in a connector insertion/extraction direction and an assembly direction. An outer housing member 50 has a sandwiched part 52 protruding from each of an inner wall surface 51a of a pair of side wall parts 51 and extending in the assembly direction and sandwiched between the first holding part and the pair of second holding parts for each of the side wall surfaces. The first holding part has a reference locking part 33a that locks a first locking part 52a of a clamped part to the reference position, the pair of second holding parts has a crushing rib 34a that is crushed by a second locking part 52b of the clamped part, and the first holding part and the pair of second holding parts clamp the clamped part by the reference locking part and the crushing rib.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: Press-fitting device
abstract: To flexibly correspond to changes in press-fitting position.SOLUTION: A press-fitting device 1 has: a robot arm 21 capable of arranging a transmission case 90 gripped by a hand 4 at designated coordinates; a servo press machine 7 in which a press-fitting jig 72 to which a bearing 95 is mounted and a backup jig Bk are arranged to face each other on a common center line C7; and a slider 75 which is provided so as to be movable in a center line C7 direction, and in which the transmission case 90 gripped by the hand is positioned on the center line C7 when the slider is engaged with a part on the hand side. In the servo press machine 7, when the part on the hand 4 side engages with the slider 75, the slider 75 moves in the center line C7 direction, and the transmission case 90 gripped by the hand 4 is supported by the backup jig Bk. Subsequently, the press-fitting jig 72 is displaced in the center line C7 direction, and the bearing 95 is press-fitted into the transmission case 90 supported by the backup jig Bk.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title: Polymer member-inorganic based matrix complex, manufacturing method thereof and polymer member therefor
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a useful method to bond a polymer member to an inorganic matrix without using glue, and the polymer member for this purpose. SOLUTION: A polymer member-inorganic based matrix complex, a manufacturing method thereof and a polymer member therefor are provided. A method to manufacture the polymer member-inorganic based matrix complexes 210, 220 includes: providing a thermal modified polymer layer-inorganic based matrix complexes 110, 120 in which one or multiple thermal modified polymer layers 20, 21, 22 adhere on an inorganic based matrix 10; and joining polymer member 30, 31, 32 to the inorganic based matrix with one or multiple thermal modified polymer layers 20, 21, 22. title: Polymer coated particles
abstract: The present invention relates to a core-shell particle, wherein the core comprises at least one chemical element, under the provision that in the case that one chemical element is present, said chemical element is not silver, and/or a compound thereof, and the shell comprises a copolymer comprising at least one monomer derived from ethylene dicarboxylic acid and at least one monomer derived from an olefin, to the use of this core-shell particle, and to a process for separating at least one first material from a mixture comprising said at least one first material and at least one second material.

title: Multifunctional catalyst, producing method thereof and use method thereof
abstract: To provide a multifunctional catalyst used for recycling polyester fabric, a producing method thereof, and a use method thereof.SOLUTION: A multifunctional catalyst 100 includes a carrier S, a first functional ionic liquid IL-1 and a second functional ionic liquid IL-2 grafted onto the carrier. The carrier is an inorganic composite powder material and is composed of a chemical component shown as C:Na-Ni/Al2O3. During recycling of polyester fabric, multifunctional catalysts can simultaneously decolorize and depolymerize polyester textiles. The first functional ionic liquid is used to decolorize the polyester fabric, and the second functional ionic liquid is used to depolymerize the polyester fabric.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Hyperbranched polymer, metal recovery agent, metal recovery method and catalytic activity inhibitor
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a novel hyperbranched polymer having high metal capturing capability and capable of being used as a metal recovery agent and a catalytic activity inhibitor. SOLUTION: A hyperbranched polymer represented by the following formula (1) and having a weight average molecular weight of 1000 to 1000000 is provided. In the formula, A 1 is a group containing an aromatic ring, A 2 is a group containing an amide group, A 3 is a group containing sulfur, m1 is 0.5 to 11, and n1 is 5 to 100. title: Laminate, printed matter, aqueous dispersion liquid, and laminate manufacturing method
abstract: The present invention provides a layered product comprising a release layer that can be formed from an aqueous coating liquid, that is quickly released from the substrate when alkaline treatment is performed, and that has excellent water resistance. The layered product of the present invention is a layered product comprising a release layer on a substrate, the release layer comprising a granular carboxylic anhydride-modified olefin resin and a binding part containing an acid group-free thermoplastic resin, the carboxylic anhydride-modified olefin resin having an average particle size of 0.5 to 20 μm, the binding part having a thickness of 0.25 to 20 μm, and the release layer having an actual acid value of 100 mg KOH/m 2 or more.

title: Image forming system, portable terminal, and program
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a technology that, in cooperation of an image forming apparatus and a portable terminal with each other, makes it possible to check that the image forming apparatus cooperating with the portable terminal is an image forming apparatus desired by a user. SOLUTION: A portable terminal 50 acquires information (information for specifying apparatus) for a user to determine whether an image forming apparatus that is to cooperate with the portable terminal 50 is a desired image forming apparatus through BLE communication (short-range radio communication) with the image forming apparatus. The portable terminal 50 displays a confirmation message 700 confirming execution of cooperation with the image forming apparatus. The confirmation message 700 includes the information for specifying apparatus (for example, apparatus name "sixth floor, east side 1"). The portable terminal 50 executes the cooperation with the image forming apparatus (for example, authentication operation) according to the user's operation to confirm the confirmation message 700. title: Information notification device, information notification system, and information notification method
abstract: To provide an information notification device that notifies an operator of information and is capable of further accurately providing notification with simple configuration.SOLUTION: An information notification device 100 includes: an operation state information acquisition unit 111 that acquires operation state information of a manufacturing device; and an operation determination unit 112 that determines an operation state of the manufacturing device. The information notification device 100 also includes a wireless signal information acquisition unit that acquires received power information indicating received power of a wireless signal transmitted from the manufacturing device to a portable terminal. The information notification device 100 also includes a position calculation unit 114 that calculates an operator distance from the manufacturing device to the operator based on the received power information. The information notification device 100 also includes a distance determination unit 115 that determines, based on the operator distance and a determination distance, a distance of the operator. The information notification device 100 further includes an abnormality information transmission unit 116 that transmits abnormality information to the portable terminal of the operator upon determination that the operator distance is greater than or equal to the determination distance.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title: Network device and processing method for network device
abstract: To allow the security of communication to be enhanced.SOLUTION: A network device includes: acquisition means that acquires proxy information set in the network device; and communication means that communicates with a management server via a proxy server using the proxy information if an aggregation mode is enabled and the proxy information is information received from the proxy server, or if the aggregation mode is not enabled, and that does not communicate with the management server if the aggregation mode is enabled and the proxy information is not information received from the proxy server.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 12

title: Receiving device
abstract: To improve the immediacy and flexibility of alerts.SOLUTION: In a related table in which processing-related information related to output processing that outputs an alarm on the receiving side is registered in association with an index, and that is provided so as to be included in data of the upper layer above a physical layer, a transmitting device generates and transmits transmission data including an index associated with the predetermined processing-related information in physical layer data. In the related table, the index is associated with the processing-related information and an area code representing the area for which the output processing is to be performed according to the processing-related information. The present technology can be applied, for example, to a case in which an emergency alarm is provided in television broadcasting.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Program and medical information management system
abstract: To provide a program and a medical information management system which can reduce a work load of a medical staff required for associating a patient, the medical staff and a medical device with each other.SOLUTION: A program causes a processor of an information terminal 30 to execute: selection processing of selecting a patient ID included in a beacon b2 having the maximum signal intensity in the plurality of beacons b2 that are received and selecting a medical device ID included in a beacon b1 having the maximum signal intensity in the plurality of beacons b1 that are received from the same type of medical devices 10; and transmission processing of transmitting the patient ID and the medical device ID to a medical information management server device 20 in such a state that the patient ID selected in the selection processing is associated with the medical device ID selected in the selection processing.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Method for producing four-season meju with lactic acid bacteria and beneficial bacteria that reduces the harmful factors of traditional soybean paste
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing lactic acid bacteria (beneficial bacteria) four-season fermented soybean lump reducing risk factors in traditional fermented sauces realized with: a raw material and auxiliary raw material bringing-in step; a selection and washing step; an immersion step; a steaming step; a starter inoculation step; a grinding step; a compression and molding step; a fermentation step; and a drying step, wherein the manufactured four-season fermented soybean lump have a remarkable effect of developing the traditional fermented soybean lumps industry into a competitive industry by making the allowable range of apratoxin and biogenic amine, which are risk factors, meet domestic and international standards.

title: Feed for marine invertebrates and method for producing feed for marine invertebrates
abstract: To provide a feed for marine invertebrates such as abalones and urchins, and to provide a method for producing the feed for marine invertebrates.SOLUTION: Provided are a feed for marine invertebrates, characterized by containing algae powders and food processing residues; and a method for producing the feed for marine invertebrates, characterized by performing a solidification step of solidifying algae powders and food processing residues.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5D

title: Preparation Method of Multidimensional Anti-Aging Nutrient
abstract: The present disclosure relates to the field of anti-aging technologies, and particularly to a preparation method of a multidimensional anti-aging nutrient. The multidimensional anti-aging nutrient includes anti-aging granules and a beauty nourishing oral liquid, wherein the anti-aging granules includes the raw materials: 10 g of Cistanche deserticola , 10 g of Morinda officinalis , 4 chrysanthemums, 10 g of Chinese wolfberry, ethanol, 10 g of lactose, 10 g of sucrose, 5 g of microcrystalline cellulose and 1 g of magnesium stearate; a process for preparing the anti-aging granules is as follows: step S1, soaking 10 g of Cistanche deserticola with yellow rice wine, then baking the soaked Cistanche deserticola , respectively smashing 10 g of Morinda officinalis without cores and 4 chrysanthemums without calyx to pass through a 20-mesh sieve, extracting the Cistanche deserticola with 60% ethanol, with a material-to-liquid ratio of 1:10, and then soaking for 30 min.

title: Recombinant components and compositions for use in food products
abstract: To provide methods for use in producing alternatives to animal-derived food products from recombinant components, as well as compositions used in and obtained from such methods.SOLUTION: Provided are methods for producing food products comprising recombinant components, and compositions used in and food products produced by such methods.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: A Manufacturing Method of Cheonggukjang Mixed with Aquilaria Agallocha
abstract: The present invention relates to functional Cheonggukjang (fast-fermented bean paste) using aloeswood leaves and a method for preparing the same. More specifically, the present invention has been described step by step. The present invention comprises: a first step of cleanly washing soybeans from which foreign substances are removed and immersing the soybeans in water at a temperature of 15-30℃ for 10-14 hours; a second step (roasting step) of roasting aloeswood leaves that have been dried and washed with water at a temperature of 130-170℃; a third step (grinding step) of grinding the roasted aloeswood leaves into powder; a fourth step (mixing step) of mixing the soaked soybeans with the aloeswood leaf powder at a weight ratio of 10:0.1-3.0; and a fifth step of mixing the mixture ingredients thereof with rice straw or inoculating the mixture ingredients with Bacillus subtilis and fermenting the mixture ingredients in a fermentation chamber for 48-72 hours. Accordingly, the preparation method of the present invention has the effects of: providing functional Cheonggukjang using aloeswood leaves, which is obtained by suppressing unique strong and unpleasant odor and taste of Cheonggukjang; increasing the unique scent of aloeswood; adding the unique efficacy of Cheonggukjang and the efficacy of aloeswood leaves so that Cheonggukjang can be provided as food which can be consumed by men and women of all ages without any repulsion; and maximizing advantages of Cheonggukjang by the combination of the unique efficacy of Cheonggukjang with the efficacy of aloeswood leaves. In particular, Cheonggukjang of the present invention can be used as a local specialty, and thus, it is expected that the present invention will increase farm income, create jobs, and further contribute to an increase in export.

title: Power Amplifier Circuit
abstract: To provide a power amplifier circuit that improves distortion characteristics and efficiency by forming a bypass path for high-frequency components.SOLUTION: A power amplifier circuit 101 comprises: a distribution circuit 41 that distributes an input signal RFin with a phase difference applied; a carrier amplifier 51 that outputs a first amplified signal RF4; a peak amplifier 52 that outputs a second amplified signal RF5; a combiner circuit 42 that combines the first amplified signal and the second amplified signal to generate a third amplified signal RFout; a first bias circuit 151 having a first bias supply terminal 151a that supplies a first bias to a second terminal of a first capacitor 61 through a resistor element 160; a second bias circuit 152 having a second bias supply terminal 152a that supplies a second bias to a second terminal of a second capacitor 62 through a resistor element 162; and a third capacitor 64 having the first terminal connected to the second capacitor 62 and the second terminal connected to the first bias supply terminal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Signal processing device
abstract: To provide a signal processing device capable of restricting its manufacturing cost.SOLUTION: A signal processing device 1 is configured including: a signal processing part 2 at least having a first operational amplifier 41 and a second operational amplifier 42; a first switch 51 for changing the connection between a signal source and a first non-inverting input terminal 410, and between a reference voltage VCOM and the first non-inverting input terminal 410; a second switch 52 for changing the connection between the signal source and a second non-inverting input terminal 420 and between the reference voltage VCOM and the second non-inverting input terminal 420; and a control part 7 for defining an offset amount 72 of a first processing signal S5a based on a second processing signal S5b outputted from the signal processing part 2 by the connection of the reference voltage VCOM, the first non-inverting input terminal 410, and the second non-inverting input terminal 420, due to the changes of the first switch 51 and the second switch 52.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Receiving module of transmission interface
abstract: A receiving module of a transmission interface is provided. The receiving module of the transmission interface includes an analog front-end (AFE) circuit and a track-and-hold circuit. The AFE circuit is used to receive an input signal to generate a first intermediate signal. The track-and-hold circuit is used to sample the first intermediate signal according to a first clock to generate a second intermediate signal, and comprises at least a first switch, at least a second switch, at least a first capacitor, and at least a second capacitor. The first switch and the second switch are turned on or off according to the first clock. The first capacitor has a first terminal and a second terminal, wherein the first terminal is coupled to the AFE circuit, and the second terminal receives a second clock. The second capacitor has a third terminal and a fourth terminal, wherein the third terminal is coupled to the AFE circuit, and the fourth terminal receives the second clock. The first clock and the second clock are inverse signals of each other.

title: Electronic device for shifting a voltage level
abstract: Electronic device for shifting a voltage level; the device comprising: a feedforward component configured for one-shot shifting a first voltage level of a first domain to a third voltage level of a third domain, wherein the third voltage level is different from the first voltage level, via at least one second voltage level of at least one second domain, wherein the at least one second voltage level is different from the first voltage level and from the third voltage level; and a feedback component configured for feeding back the third voltage level from the third domain to the at least one second domain.

title: Amplifier circuit and communication device
abstract: To provide an amplifier circuit in which the distortion of output characteristics of high-frequency signals is suppressed.SOLUTION: An amplifier circuit 1 includes an amplifying transistor 11 connected to a signal input terminal 110, a power supply circuit 22 configured to supply a bias voltage vg1a to the amplifying transistor 11, a resistor 32 arranged in series in a bias path connecting the power supply circuit 22 and the amplifying transistor 11, a transistor 21, which is connected to the bias path and power supply circuit 22 and used to simulate the amplifying transistor 11, and a detection diode 31 connected to a bias path between the resistor 32 and the gate of the amplifying transistor 11 and the signal input terminal 110.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Semiconductor optical element
abstract: To distinguish the orientation of a semiconductor optical element.SOLUTION: A semiconductor optical element includes a substrate 16 which has a first side surface 20 and a second side surface 22 opposed to each other and in which the first side surface 20 is flat; the second side surface 22 includes an upper side surface 22U and a lower side surface 22L; and the lower side surface 22L protrudes from the upper side surface 22U to form a step, an optical function layer 24 which is located on the top surface of the substrate 16 and has a first end surface 26 and a second end surface 28 opposite to each other, the first end surface 26 being flush with the first side surface 20 and the second end surface 28 being flush with the upper side surface 22U of the second side surface 22, a first film 42 that continuously covers the first end surface 26 and the first side surface 20, a second film 44 which is different in reflectance from the first film 42, and continuously covers the second end surface 28 and the upper side surface 22U of the second side surface 22, a first electrode 38 electrically connected to the upper surface of the optical functional layer 24, and a second electrode 40 electrically connected to the lower surface of the optical functional layer 24.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: Electro-optic device and electronic apparatus
abstract: To provide an electro-optic device in which electrical damage caused when a contact hole is formed is reduced.SOLUTION: A scanning line 241 and a gate electrode 232 of a first TFT 23A are electrically connected in a thickness direction through a first contact hole 276A, the scanning line 241 and the gate electrode 232 of a second TFT 23B are electrically connected in a thickness direction through a second contact hole 276B, the scanning line 241 and a first light-shielding layer 254A are electrically connected in a thickness direction through a third contact hole 275A, the scanning line 241 and a second light-shielding layer 254B are electrically connected in a thickness direction through a fourth contact hole 275B, the first light-shielding layer 254A and the gate electrode 232 of the first TFT 23A are electrically connected in a thickness direction through a fifth contact hole 280, and the second light-shielding layer 254B and the gate electrode 232 of the second TFT 23B are electrically connected in a thickness direction through a sixth contact hole 281.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title: Optical semiconductor element, optical unit and method for manufacturing optical unit
abstract: To simply and efficiently introduce light into a waveguide member.SOLUTION: An optical semiconductor element 10 includes: a semiconductor substrate 2 having a first main surface 2a and a second main surface 2b on the side opposite to the first main surface 2a; a laminate 3 formed on the first main surface 2a and including an active layer 33 and a contact layer 35 arranged on the side opposite to the semiconductor substrate 2 to the active layer 33; a first electrode 4 contacting the contact layer 35; and a second electrode 5 formed on the second main surface 2b. The laminate 3 includes a light transmission part 36 formed without covering at least a part 350 of a surface 35a on the side opposite to the semiconductor substrate 2 in the contact layer 35 with the first electrode 4. The optical semiconductor element 10 is constituted so as not to form a waveguide mode by current application through the first electrode 4 and a second electrode 5 in the state that the light transmission part 36 is optically in non-contact with an external member.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: Transfer substrate, electronic device and manufacturing method of transfer substrate
abstract: To provide a transfer substrate capable of improving a yield, an electronic device and a manufacturing method of the transfer substrate.SOLUTION: A transfer substrate comprises: a substrate including a first top face; a conductive film which is provided on the substrate and includes a second top face; and a first insulator film which is provided on the substrate and directly in contact with the conductive film and includes a third top face continued to the second top face. The second top face and the third top face are tilted from the first top face in a boundary between the second top face and the third top face.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Display device
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To improve credibility of a semiconductor device. SOLUTION: A semiconductor device has a drive circuit part and a display part (also referred to as a pixel part) on the same substrate. The drive circuit part and the display part each have a thin film transistor where a semiconductor layer is composed of an oxide semiconductor, first wiring, and second wiring. The thin film transistor has a source electrode layer or a drain electrode layer with an outer edge lying inside an outer edge of the semiconductor layer. In the thin film transistor of the drive circuit part, the semiconductor layer is sandwiched between a gate electrode layer and a conductive layer; and the first wiring and the second wiring are electrically connected via an oxide conductive layer in an opening formed in a gate insulation layer. title: Compositions and methods for treatment of kidney diseases
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide methods and compositions for increasing the expression of a protein, and for treating a subject in need thereof, e.g., a subject with deficient protein expression or a subject having a kidney disease. SOLUTION: Provided is a method comprising the step of contacting the cells of a subject with an antisense oligomer (ASO), which is complementary to the targeted portion of RIC pre-mRNA encoding a target protein or functional RNA, whereby the retained intron is constitutively spliced from the RIC pre-mRNA encoding the target protein or functional RNA, thereby increasing the level of mRNA encoding the target protein or functional RNA, and in the cells of the subject, increasing the expression of the target protein or functional RNA. title: Multispecific and multifunctional molecular and use of the same
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a multispecific or a multifunctional molecular polypeptide used in cancer treatment. SOLUTION: A multispecific or a multifunctional molecular polypeptide includes: (i) a tumor targeting portion binding to cancer antigen, which is a first tumor targeting portion for example; (ii) an immunocyte engager selected from an NK-cell engager, a T-cell engager, a B-cell engager, a dendritic cell engager or a macrophage cell engager; (iii) cytokine molecules; and (iv) two or all of interstitial adjustment portions. title: Anti-her2 combinations for treating cancer
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a therapeutic combination for treating cancer by using combinational therapy. abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a probe for sequencing, a reporter probe and a method in which nucleic acid sequencing that is quickly executed with no enzyme, no amplification and no library, and has a low error rate with a long read-out length. SOLUTION: A probe including a primary nucleic acid molecule which hybridizes with at least six secondary nucleic acid molecules, in which each of the plurality of secondary nucleic acid molecules hybridizes with at least five tertiary nucleic acid molecules, and each of the tertiary nucleic acid molecules includes at least one detectable label. title: Modular targeted therapeutic agents and methods of making same
abstract: Provided herein are methods for making targeted therapeutics. In several embodiments, the therapeutics are directed against soluble agents such as toxins, venoms, and/or other factors that alter physiological biopathways as well as methods of using such therapeutics to treat patients or patient populations to reduce, eliminate, or inactivate, detrimental soluble agents that such patients or patient populations have been exposed to. In several embodiments, the therapeutics are directed to patient-specific disease markers. In several embodiments, the methods comprise screening a library comprising proteins linked to their cognate mRNAs to identify mRNA-protein pairs that bind to the diseased cells, isolating one or more proteins from the identified mRNA-protein pairs, and conjugating the isolated protein(s) to a therapeutic agent.

title: Baking apparatus
abstract: To improve a recovery rate of a volatile matter volatilized from an object.SOLUTION: The firing apparatus includes an accommodation portion having an internal space for accommodating an object, equipment to which the accommodation portion is detachably attached and which has an equipment flow path communicating with the internal space, a pump connected to the equipment flow path and configured to discharge gas in the internal space, a trap portion disposed in the internal space and configured to trap a volatile component volatilized from the object, a heating portion configured to heat the object, and a cooling portion configured to cool the trap portion.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: Liquified hydrogen transfer system and intermediate transfer facility and purge method of the same
abstract: To enable gas exhaustion through a vent line to be properly performed in a system which transfers liquified hydrogen.SOLUTION: A liquefied hydrogen transfer system TS1 comprises: a first facility 1 including a first tank 11 capable of storing liquefied hydrogen; a second facility 2 including a second tank 21 capable of storing the liquefied hydrogen; and an intermediate transfer facility 3 disposed between the first facility 1 and the second facility 2. The intermediate transfer facility 3 includes a transfer line 4 that transfers the liquefied hydrogen between the first tank 11 and the second tank 21, a purge line 5 that supplies purge gas to the transfer line 4, a vent line 6 that exhausts gas containing the purge gas from the transfer line 4, a branch line 7 that branches from the vent line 6 and merges with the vent line 6 at a downstream position in an exhaust direction with respect to a position of the branch, and a thermometer 8 that is disposed in the branch line 7 and measures the temperature of the gas flowing through the branch line 7.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Cooling device
abstract: To provide a cooling device capable of quickly solving clogging of a filter without causing failure.SOLUTION: A cooling device has: a case 3 in which an apparatus 2 cooled by a fluid which is a liquid is stored; a circulation passage 4 formed at the case 3 and connected to a supply port 10 for supplying a fluid into the case 3 and to a discharge port 11 for discharging the fluid from the case 3, respectively; a normal rotation side filter 6 provided at the discharge port 11; a pump 7 provided at the circulation passage 4; and a control device 8 for controlling an operation of the pump 7. By switching a fluid discharge direction of the pump 7 by the control device 8, switching is possible between a normal mode for delivering the fluid discharged from the discharge port 11 to the supply port 10 via the circulation passage 4 and a reverse rotation mode for delivering the fluid into the case 3 from the discharge port 11.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: oil separator
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an oil separator that makes it easy to check the quantity of drain liquid. SOLUTION: An oil separator 5 comprises: an intake port 16 into which compressed air flows; an exhaust port 17 from which clean air is expelled; a filter part for separating compressed air into gas and liquid; a drain bowl 30 for impounding drain liquid separated from compressed air; and a protective cover 80 for protecting a translucent part. The entire drain bowl 30 is a translucent part through which its inside can be viewed. SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3 COPYRIGHT: (C)2023,JPO&INPIT

title: Supercritical fluid exhaust system and method
abstract: An object of the embodiment is to provide a supercritical fluid exhaust system capable of controlling a fluid discharge rate of an exhaust line and a method thereof. According to an embodiment, the fluid exhaust system comprises: a chamber in which a supercritical treatment process for the substrate is performed; an exhaust for discharging supercritical fluid from the chamber; a main exhaust line connected to the exhaust; and a pressure control unit installed in the main exhaust line. The pressure control unit may increase exhaust pressure when internal pressure of the chamber falls below set pressure.

title: eco-friendly stone octopus habitat block
abstract: The present invention relates to an eco-friendly stone octopus habitat block, comprising: a block main body having a predetermined shape; and a central passage formed by penetrating through the block main body and providing a habitat environment for sea creatures, wherein the block main body is formed of stone, and the surface roughness of an inner wall surface of the central passage is greater than the surface roughness of an outer wall surface of the block main body.

title: Use of a combination of glycine, l-proline, l-lysine, l-aspartic acid, citric acid and vitamin c, in the non-therapeutical improvement of physical fitness, preventing fatigue and physical aging in physical exercise in a subject
abstract: The present invention is a method to improve physical-sports performance, reduce fatigue, combat physical-sports aging, and to cure and prevent physical injuries, based on an effective dose of glycine, L-proline, L-lysine, L-aspartic acid (or L-aspartate, citric acid, or citrate), and vitamin C. The method is based on the limitations and subsequent conditions of the metabolism in three aspects: (1) the synthesis of ATP in mitochondria, dependent on the Krebs cycle; (2) the synthesis of proteins of the passive mechanical system (collagen and elastin); (3) the mechanism of muscle contraction in actin-myosin interaction cross-bridge cycles. while ensuring that the diet must contain a sufficient amount of protein.

title: Substrate cleaning device, substrate processing device, and maintenance method for substrate cleaning device
abstract: A substrate cleaning device (31) comprises a roll cleaning member (61) and a rotary holding unit (100). The rotary holding unit (100) includes a contactless seal portion (140) disposed between a bearing portion (130) and the roll cleaning member (61) and sealing a gap between a shaft portion (110) and a housing portion (120). The contactless seal portion (140) comprises: a rotary portion (150) attached to the shaft portion (110) and having a plurality of protrusions (151) axially spaced apart and formed on a peripheral surface (150a); and a fixed portion (160) attached to the housing portion (120) and surrounding the plurality of protrusions (151), the plurality of protrusions (151) being surrounded by an inner peripheral surface (160a) having a gas supply hole (161) formed therein to supply compressed gas (200) from a position axially inside those protrusions (151) among the plurality of protrusions (151) that are disposed at both end portions axially.

title: High wattage power over ethernet illumination fixtures
abstract: The techniques described herein relate to methods and apparatus for a power over Ethernet (PoE) light for media applications. The PoE light includes a light, wherein the light requires a wattage of at least 30 watts for proper operation. The PoE light includes a processor configured to control the light. The PoE light includes a port in electrical communication with the processor, wherein the port is configured to receive an Ethernet cable that provides communication with a router, wherein the router provides over the Ethernet cable both: power for the PoE light to operate at the wattage, and data communications for the PoE light so that the processor can transmit and receive data communications according to DMX (Digital Multiplex) protocol so the light can be remotely controlled by a user.
